meta.title: Scholars and Sufis of the Maghrib in the Fifteenth and Sixteenth Centuries
meta.source: This dataset records the social network of scholars and Sufis in the Maghrib during the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. It is derived from Dawḥat al-nāshir li-maḥāsin man kāna bi-l-Maghrib min mashāyikh al-qarn al-ʿāshir by Ibn ʿAskar al-Shafshāwanī (d. 986/1578), and was originally prepared for Palladio to visualize the network on a map.
